capabilities: Convert Obsidian Markdown syntax to other Markdown platforms
Process notes placed in a designated ready folder
Support Jekyll Chirpy and Docusaurus as output targets
Trigger conversion via the O2: Grammar Transformation command
disambiguation: Not a publishing tool that uploads posts for you; it only converts note syntax into the target platform's Markdown.
extras: Development of new features has been discontinued; the author is building a new tool not tied to Obsidian. Detailed documentation lives outside the README, which links articles about the plugin.
problem: Obsidian Markdown syntax is not valid on other Markdown platforms, so publishing notes to Jekyll or Docusaurus requires manual rewriting.

relations.evidence: Plugins that work well together - imgur: Recommanded

summary: Markdown converter that transforms Obsidian syntax into formats for other Markdown platforms such as Jekyll and Docusaurus.
